context.p: To replace a fuse in the inner panel, follow these steps:

step.cmd: Make sure the vehicle and all other switches are in the OFF position.
Pull the suspected fuse straight out using the removal tool provided in the engine compartment’s main fuse box.
Check if the fuse you removed is blown. If so, replace the fuse.

info.p: Spare fuses are provided in the instrument panel fuse panel (or in the engine compartment fuse panel).

step.cmd: To replace the blown fuse, push in a new fuse of the same rating and make sure it fits tightly in the clips.

info.p: If the new fuse does not fit tightly, have your vehicle serviced by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
If you do not have a spare fuse, replace the blown fuse with one of the same rating from a circuit you may not need to operate the vehicle, such as the cigarette lighter fuse.

If the vehicle’s exterior and interior lamps do not work and their fuses are not blown, have your vehicle serviced by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
